title: How Is a Rainbow Made? 🌈
description:
How Is a Rainbow Made? A rainbow! Sunlight looks white, but it's really made of many colors.
A quick science and how things work Short for curious kids ages 4–8, with Gizmo the robot.

Sunlight is made of many colors. When it shines through raindrops, the colors spread out into a rainbow!

Gizmo the little robot loves to ask "How does that work?" Simple, true science for curious kids ages 4-8. New videos every day! Characters and visuals are animated with the help of AI tools and every script is reviewed for kid safety.

title: How Does Weather Work? 5 Weather Wonders for Kids
description:
How Does Weather Work? 5 Weather Wonders for Kids: a 5-minute science and how things work video for curious kids ages 4–8. Meet the Rain, Rainbow, Lightning, Snow and Wind.
Learn with Gizmo the robot: guess-what clues, move-along fun and a recap at the end.

What we learn today:
• Rain falls from heavy clouds.
• Rainbows need sun and rain.
• Lightning flashes, then thunder booms.
• Snow is frozen ice crystals.
• And wind is moving air!
